sections.Profile:
"Domino's Spectacular Pinball Adventure" is a pinball machine released in July 2016 by Spooky Pinball LLC. Featuring two flippers, two ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode, the game is built on the PinHeck system. It was designed by Charlie Emery with artwork by Blake Dumesnil and Scott Gullicks. The game, themed around Domino's Pizza, had a limited production run of 136 units.
